column1: # The repo fleet. Data, not code — adding a repo is one line here, never a script edit.
#   role       product | infra | archive — `archive` is cloned only with --all
#   pm         npm | pnpm | none  — none means nothing to install
#   bootstrap  extra command run in the repo after install, or `-`
# Tabs between fields. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Retained for reference, not active work. QuantaForge is NetWorthy's prior art
